eps.o: Guy Fieri asks GGG fans what grocery games they want to see and the results are wild.
Guy Fieri welcomes all-star chefs Joe Sasto, Lee Anne Wong, and Justin Warner to an intense noodle competition.
Three experienced grill masters are ready to fight fire with fire in hopes of defeating each other, and ultimately an all-star GGG judge, in an epic grill-off.
Guy Fieri invites three GGG winners to celebrate America's 250th birthday with a cook-off.

Guy Fieri invites eight all-star masters of world cuisines to compete in a five-part GGG Global Games for $50,000! After dividing the chefs into two groups, Guy asks Group A to make their best international street food that includes pumpernickel bread

The Global Games continue as Guy Fieri asks the chefs to make their best international fried dish that also includes Haitian peanut butter. Then, the bottom two chefs fight for survival by preparing their best noodle dish using only 8 lbs. of ingredients

Six chefs are still in the running for the Global Games $50,000 prize. Guy Fieri asks Group A chefs to make a spicy favorite using ingredients that echo colors from their countries' flags. The Group B chefs make a Sunday supper inspired by their country
The remaining chefs make a seafood dinner and a hot-cold duo

Guy Fieri challenges the final two chefs to make a showstopping appetizer in only 20 minutes and a country-defining entree and dessert with only 40 dollars and 40 minutes. The chef with the highest combined score after two rounds wins the $50,000 prize!

Guy Fieri invites firefighters to partner with all-star chefs for a special team competition. The firefighters and their all-star sous chefs make a 20-minute firehouse breakfast to win $2,500, followed by a complete firehouse dinner to win up to $20,000

Guy Fieri welcomes the first three winners of GGG to return and compete for up to $20,000. First, the chefs must make a baller burger and side, even though all buns are out of stock. Then, the final two make a high-end dinner featuring only frozen foods

Guy Fieri invites three foodies with big online followings to team up with their favorite all-star chefs in a high-energy competition.
Guy Fieri invites three GGG newcomers to spread their wings to make two rounds of dishes using a single chicken.
